focal_blueprints.title_zh: 图表小作文首段：题目改写与总体趋势概览（Paraphrase + Macro Overview）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Academic Task 1 首段（Introduction + Overview）或实验趋势总览段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [图表命题同义改写 Prompt Paraphrase]：The line graph / bar chart compares [Variable/Metric] across [Categories/Regions] over a [N]-year period from [Year A] to [Year B].
S2 [宏观趋势 1：总体走向与反超 Overview Trend 1]：Overall, while [Category A and B] experienced a steady upward trajectory, [Category C] declined markedly, leading to a reversal in dominance around [Mid-Year].
S3 [宏观趋势 2：极值或差距特征 Overview Trend 2]：Notably, [Category A] registered the most dramatic growth throughout the period, ultimately overtaking all other sectors to become the primary contributor.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Paraphrase -> Overall Trajectory Contrast -> Dominant Crossover/Extremum (Zero raw numbers in Overview!). 绑定逻辑规则：L013, L015.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The chart shows the energy consumption from 2000 to 2025. We can see that solar energy went up a lot from 5% to 35%, and coal went down from 60% to 25%. Wind also went up.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: ① 词汇低幼（went up a lot, went down）；② 把具体百分比过早塞进了 Overview，导致后面细节段无话可写。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The line graph compares the proportion of electricity generated from four fuel sources across three industrial economies between 2000 and 2025. Overall, renewable sources—particularly solar and wind power—followed a pronounced upward trajectory over the 25-year span, whereas coal reliance contracted steadily. Most notably, clean energy generation overtook fossil-fuel consumption around 2018, shifting from a marginal supplement to the dominant power supply by the end of the period.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 问题诊断与靶向解决方案段：拒绝“政府应该立法”万金油（Targeted Problem-Solution）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / 政策与工程治理方案段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [对策总起句 Targeted Solution Thesis]：Mitigating [Problem X] effectively requires coordinated intervention across both [Level A: Technical/Curriculum Design] and [Level B: Institutional Governance].

S2 [对策 1：操作层可验证改革 Actionable Measure 1]：First, [Specific Actor 1, e.g., university departments] should replace [Vulnerable Practice] with [Verifiable Mechanism, e.g., oral defense and in-class iterative drafting], ensuring that [Specific Effect 1].

S3 [对策 2：制度/标准层激励对齐 Actionable Measure 2]：Concurrently, [Specific Actor 2, e.g., regulatory agencies / industry consortia] must establish [Concrete Standard, e.g., mandatory provenance watermarking and audit logs] to penalize [Misconduct].
S4 [协同闭环效果 Combined Outcome]：Together, aligning pedagogical verification with technical traceability curbs misuse without stifling legitimate innovation.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dual-Level Intervention -> Actor 1 + Concrete Mechanism -> Actor 2 + Concrete Standard -> Balanced Closure. 绑定逻辑规则：L002, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的中式六级万金油套话（pass strict laws, raise awareness, Only in this way can we...），放之四海而皆空，考官已产生严重审美疲劳。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Curbing the proliferation of fabricated academic data requires coordinated reforms across both peer-review protocols and institutional promotion criteria. First, journal editorial boards should mandate that empirical submissions include executable code containers and raw sensor logs, enabling automated reproducibility checks before external review. Concurrently, university tenure committees must shift evaluation weight from raw publication counts toward verified open-source contributions and replication studies. Aligning technical verification with career incentives removes the underlying pressure to fabricate incremental results.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 动态时间序列趋势分段描述（暴涨、缓降、平台期与拐点）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写动态折线图（或模型训练收敛曲线）的主体细节段：把一条经历“初期缓慢爬升 -> 中期爆发增长 -> 后期高位平台期”的曲线，以及另一条“冲高回落”的曲线对比写活。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 动态图主体段 / 论文训练动力学与收敛曲线分析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [起始点位对比 Initial Standing]：At the beginning of the period in [2000], [Entity A] stood at a modest [12%],less than a quarter of [Entity B]'s initial figure ([54%]).

S2 [多阶段演进：缓升转暴涨 Phased Acceleration]：After rising marginally over the firstfive years, [Entity A] surged nearly threefold between [2005] and [2018], peaking at [48%] before stabilizing on a high plateau.
S3 [反向曲线对比：冲高回落 Counter-Trajectory]：Conversely, [Entity B] climbed briefly to [61%] in [2004] but subsequently entered a prolonged decline, dropping by more than half to [24%] by [2025].
S4 [终局交叉总结 Terminal Comparison]：Consequently, the initial [42]-percentage-point gap between the two categories had completely reversed by the final year.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Initial Disparity -> Multi-Phase Surge & Plateau (Entity A) -> Peak-then-Decline (Entity B) -> Gap Reversal. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L013.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In 2000, A was 12% and B was 54%. Then in 2005, A increased to 15%. In 2018, A increased to 48%. In 2025, A was 47%. B increased to 61% in 2004, and then decreased to 24% in 2025.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的“流水账报年份数字”（In 2000... In 2005... In 2018...），句式单一且毫无趋势洞察。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: In 2000, battery-electric vehicles accounted for a mere 4% of municipal fleet purchases, trailing diesel buses at 62%. Following five years of marginal fluctuation, electric adoption accelerated sharply after 2006, quadrupling to 38% by 2018 before leveling off at approximately 41% through 2025. By contrast, diesel procurement peaked briefly at 67% in 2004 but subsequently underwent a sustained contraction, plunging to 19% by the end of the survey. This divergent trajectory reversed the initial 58-percentage-point deficit into a more than twofold lead for electric fleets.

focal_logic_rules.category: Domain Discourse (具身智能专属论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 具身智能感知-决策-控制闭环与 Sim-to-Real 论证规范（Embodied AI Closed-Loop Logic）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Embodied Perception-Action Loop and Sim-to-Real Logic
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 论述具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人策略时，严禁将其等同于静态图像识别。必须突出**闭环反馈（Closed-loop feedback）**、**分布外状态累积偏移（Covariate shift in sequential decision-making）**、**接触动力学不确定性（Contact-rich dynamics）**以及**机载实时推理延迟约束（Onboard real-time latency）**。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Unlike static perception where errors remain isolated, closed-loop manipulation compounds small action deviations into out-of-distribution states. -> To maintain stability under contact uncertainty, our policy [Mechanism].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 把机器人控制写得像普通分类任务（The robot looks at the image and outputs the right class of movement）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: The robot sees the image from the camera and predicts the action to pick up the cup accurately.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Unlike static visual recognition where prediction errors remain isolated across samples, closed-loop robotic manipulation compounds minor trajectory deviations into unfamiliar contact states. To prevent this covariate drift during precision assembly, our visuomotor policy conditions short-horizon action chunks on real-time wrist force-torque feedback.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 鲜明对比静态视觉与闭环操作中的误差累积（covariate drift），并引出视觉-力觉多模态短视野动作块控制机制。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 延续链式推进模式（Linear Chain Progression）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 阐述因果机制、算法推导或仿真到真实迁移（Sim-to-Real）链条时，严格采用 A -> B，B -> C，C -> D 的咬合结构，上一句的宾语转化为下一句的主语。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: S1: A induces B. -> S2: This B distorts C. -> S3: Once C degrades, D collapses.
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 中间跳过关键传导环节（如直接从 A 跳到 D），或者链条顺序颠倒。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Unmodeled friction in simulated joints causes real-world grasping failure. Domain randomization often fails because state transitions diverge.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Unmodeled joint friction in simulators creates a systematic discrepancy between synthetic and physical state transitions. This transition mismatch misleads visuomotor policies during contact-rich phases, ultimately causing real-world grasping failures.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 通过 synthetic and physical state transitions -> This transition mismatch -> contact-rich phases -> grasping failures 形成严密的四环机械传导链。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: The chart shows the energy consumption from 2000 to 2025. We can see that solar energy went up a lot from 5% to 35%, and coal went down from 60% to 25%. Wind also went up.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L025 具身智能感知-决策-控制闭环与 Sim-to-Real 论证规范（Embodied AI Closed-Loop Logic））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: ① 词汇低幼（went up a lot, went down）；② 把具体百分比过早塞进了 Overview，导致后面细节段无话可写。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。

Most notably, clean energy generation overtook fossil-fuel consumption around 2018, shifting from a marginal supplement to the dominant power supply by the end of the period.

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。

To address your valuable suggestions, we conducted four sets of new experiments during the rebuttal period (incorporated in blue in the revised manuscript): (1) Benchmarked against two latest 2025 foundation models, Chronos and MOIRAI, across all horizons (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Added real-robot grasping evaluations under dynamic lighting and 25% camera occlusion (Section 4.5, R2); and (3) Included full GPU memory and wall-clock latency scaling curves up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R4). Below we address each reviewer's specific questions in detail.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Bridging non-stationary robustness and amplitude fidelity remains a core bottleneck in long-horizon forecasting. While instance normalization strips time-varying mean and variance shifts to stabilize attention weights, it simultaneously erases physical scale cues required to predict extreme load peaks. Conversely, retaining raw unnormalized inputs exposes self-attention layers to severe covariate shift, causing validation error to diverge over extended horizons. Resolving this tension requires a mechanism that disentangles intrinsic temporal dynamics from transient scale drift without discarding magnitude information.
